stage: Phase 3a-B fix freeze, confirmatory re-run (C stage of the one-freeze flow): career side bias on fresh seeds
authority: Owner 2026-10-29 item 6: approve 'screening -> one semantics freeze -> one re-validation'; the career confirmatory study uses fresh seeds and must be registered and de-duplicated first; stage1_formal_acceptance_registration_3aB.json step 2
basis: identical design, metric, comparison and thresholds to the committed career side-bias study (tools/fixtures/side_bias_registration_3aB.json, paths.career; result tools/fixtures/side_bias_result_career_3aB.json PASS at fingerprint 0578fa882d74b205); only the seed block, the v21 arm's fingerprint and this status differ
metric: blue win rate per layout; a match with no winner at the cap counts 0.5; bias(arm, layout) = blueWinRate - 0.5
comparison: the v21 arm against the v20 arm on the same seeds (paired); worse_pp = (|bias_v21| - |bias_v20|) x 100 per layout; paired per-seed d = (win_v21 - win_v20) x s, s = the sign of the larger |bias| of the two arms (so a flip to the other side that grows the bias counts as worsening); z = mean(d) / (sd(d)/sqrt(n))

thresholds.STOP: in either layout: worse_pp >= 5, or z >= 3 in the worsening direction
thresholds.WARN: in either layout: worse_pp >= 3, or |median duration v21 / median duration v20 - 1| > 0.10
thresholds.PASS: data complete, no STOP and no WARN
thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE: the walk ends at the limit without both layouts reaching the target, or more than 2% invalid seeds (circuit breaker => STOP)

report: blue win rate and bias per arm and layout
pure blue advantage = mean of the two layouts' bias
descriptive comparison with the committed 27001-31999 result (never pooled, never used for the verdict)
errors: errored matches are never retried; more than 2% invalid seeds => circuit breaker STOP
costs: about 4,018 matches (2 arms x 2,009 seeds if the walk stops at 55017 as expected), about 1.5-1.8 h single line
status: READY_FOR_FREEZE: text final, NOT runnable. Becomes runnable only after (1) the Owner approves the single semantics freeze (Owner 2026-11-02), (2) `fingerprint` is filled with the frozen v21 candidate fingerprint and this status is changed to start with "registered", (3) an independent Reviewer confirms this file with the freeze in hand. Until then --run refuses. Nothing here may change after the first match
circuitBreaker: more than 2% invalid seeds after >= 100 walked => STOP(CIRCUIT_BREAKER), Owner decides
halt: a HALT file in the data folder blocks --run and --report until the Owner decides

career.entry: prepareLiveMatch (formal live entry) via tools/lib/careerLiveInputs.mjs: golden live inputs, mirroredRoster(seed), blue = std tactic-book binding with no choices, opponent AI_TEAMS[seed % 7]; career.v21 red = AI coach v1 (with the frozen TEMPLATE_BALANCE layer if the freeze includes it), career.v20 red = style template

seeds.stopRule: walk odd seeds ascending; include every seed; stop after the first seed at which both layouts (objectiveLayoutForSeed(effectiveSeed)) have >= 1000 valid seeds; expected stop 55017 (STANDARD 1000 / SWAPPED 1009, check_study_seed_plan_3aB L1)
